The Perceptual Quality Auditor's low severity score for blur (0.2) underestimates the issue, as the blur is likely an AI artifact masking structural failures rather than just photographic depth-of-field. I am upgrading the severity of the structural collapse/fusion to 3.5 due to the corroborating pose auditor evidence.
